profile.summary: Beynon Sports makes and installs synthetic athletic surfaces such as running tracks, indoor fieldhouse surfaces and tennis courts for colleges, high schools and city parks. The company was founded by John T. Beynon and has been part of Tarkett Sports, which also owns FieldTurf, since 2008. It is based in Hunt Valley, Maryland, and has a West Coast office in Fresno, California.
